page.overview:
What is Waltar?

Waltar was a planet on which Dwitzel worked in a brothel before rejoining the Republic Army.

Waltar was created by Jean Balczesak for an ambiguously canon roleplaying Gamemaster help which appeared in the French magazine Casus Belli 67.
